headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: HCC reported a subdued Q2FY27 performance, as a stagnant order book weighed on revenue and a lower-margin execution mix put pressure on margins.
Consolidated revenue stood at INR 897 cr (-6.7% YoY; -9.7% QoQ).
EBITDA came in at INR 103 cr (-30.4% YoY; -1.8% QoQ), with EBITDA margin at 11.5% (-390 bps YoY; +100 bps QoQ).
PAT stood at INR 23 cr (-52.8% YoY; - 55.8% QoQ), with PAT margin at 2.5% (-250 bps YoY; -260 bps QoQ).
valuation: HCC holds L1 bids worth INR 2,010 cr (HCC share INR 1,557 cr), while 16 bids worth ~INR 34,805 cr (HCC share ~INR 32,386 cr) are under evaluation.
The company targets roughly doubling its order book by FY27 end, supported by a pipeline of INR 85,907 cr across hydro, metro, nuclear, industrial and urban infrastructure segments.
HCC prepaid INR 100 cr of debt in Q2FY27 and targets a further INR 108 cr by December 2026, with ~INR 350 cr of repayment due in March 2027.
watch: HCC remains focused on profitable growth through disciplined bidding, client selection and risk pricing.

This should support liquidity and further debt reduction.  Steady progress across key projects: At Indore Metro, both TBMs have started tunnelling (12 km of tunnelling across 7 underground stations).
